title: Eth Garage
tagline: Track, trace and record repair work orders, invoices and receipts for vehicles using Sign Protocol, DeSoC using Farcaster on Gnosis Chain and Arbitrum SDK, analytics tools on Filecoin and Arbitrum Stylus Testnet and Web3 ecosystem tools on Avail.

prizes.title: Best Use Case of Neon EVM

prizes.placement: Decentralize your dApps with Filecoin - Runner Ups
prizes.title: Decentralize your dApps with Filecoin - Runner Ups

description:
Track, trace and record repair work orders, invoices and receipts for vehicles using Sign Protocol, DeSoC using Farcaster on Gnosis Chain and Arbitrum SDK, analytics tools on Filecoin IPC, and Arbitrum Stylus Testnet and Web3 ecosystem tools on Avail, Neon EVM.

There are 2 key features of our solution:

Web3 Transform: For digitizing spare parts inventory tracking pipeline forms, analyzing data, and automating vehicle maintenance workflows on Arbitrum and Filecoin IPC. Validation and Weekly insights using Avail DA layer on Risc0 VM.

Web3 Monitor Anywhere: For developers building cross-platform monitoring dapps on Arbitrum and Filecoin using sensors with low code while retaining dapp core principles and flexibility.

We are also developing tools to enable tracing, monitoring and recording of invoices in a scalable manner across an entire supply chain for efficiency and sustainability and benefit the entire mobility eco-system using Avail for data accessibility layer and Sign Protocol for verification. 

We are extending the Sign Protocol to develop the Attestation Hub smart contract for Vehicle Service and Repair Work Orders, Invoices and Reports. 

We are developing a KYC decentralized application using Risc0 ZKVM for vehicle owners and vehicle service providers that allows them to verify and mint their identity as an NFT enabling onchain identity verification with zero-knowledge proofs.

Filecoin IPC and Filecoin Virtual Machine (FVM) enables us to use building blocks exposed through interfaces, enabling the construction of incident archiving solutions. This improves better outcomes for vehicle maintenance, service and repair. We are using FVM and Filecoin IPC for:

Creating a Vehicle Service Ticket NFT on the FVM for NFC tags of service and repair providers to improve service/repair operations, decentralized NFT-based voting system for contract work by service providers, Votes are uploaded to IPFS with the most recent vote linking to one before.

Filecoin IPC to enable scalability and token bridge operations using ERC20 token supply across multiple platforms and blockchains that improve the overall usability and interoperability.

Further, we are developing a NeonVM utiliy token (Park Pro Token) using Neon transfer SDK, Open Zeppelin and enabling Smart incentivization using both Ethereum and Solana, Gnosis Pay with QR code dapp, EtherCalc.

Vehicle Repair and Service NFTs on Farcaster and Gnosis Chain enable:
- Enable hyperlocal vehicle service and repair delivery information.
- Enable QR code based blockchain payments at parking sites with support for key blockchain platforms.
- Enhance road safety through smart incentivization of incident reporting by citizens.
how_its_made:
We are developing tools to track, trace and record listing and maintenance of vehicles on Farcaster, receive active service/repair NFT badges and marketplaces, maintain CRM of prospective service providers using Neynar, verification using Sign Protocol and account abstraction using zero knowledge proofs built using circom and noir deployed on Polygon zkEVM, Arbitrum, Gnosis Chain and Filecoin, Web3 ecosystem tools.

We are using Arbitrum and Farcaster to develop Repair NFT badges and marketplace with NFT badges issued to Vehicle Service providers on completion of repair work/vehicle servicing built using Arbitrum Stylus programs in Rust. We are extending the starter template for writing Arbitrum Stylus programs in Rust using the stylus-sdk.

We are also developing tools to enable tracing, monitoring and recording of spare parts inventory and receipts, invoices in a scalable manner using Arbitrum SDK, Gnosis Chain, Sign Protocol and Filecoin IPC.

We are developing AA tools to plan vehicle maintenance activities, receive anonymous feedback reports by vehicle owners, store feedback details and strategize more productively and do early stage prevention of vehicle maintenance issues. We are enabling onchain composability using Filecoin IPC and extending the reports as frames quickly on Farcaster.

We are also developing AA tools to support operations like sending DAI and USDC payment amounts, zk signing of the transaction and other cryptographic operations across multiple platforms and blockchains that improve the overall usability and interoperability.

We are developing a KYC decentralized application using Risc0 ZKVM for vehicle owners and vehicle service providers that allows them to verify and mint their identity as an NFT enabling onchain identity verification with zero-knowledge proofs.

We are also using RISC Zero zkVM and submitting data to Avail DA for weekly work order insights at the vehicle repair/maintenance location.
